title: Build App component and compose all features
active_form: Building App component and composing all features
description:
Create the App component that composes TodoInput, TodoList, TodoFooter, and the toast system into the complete application. Wire the useTodos hook to provide state and action functions to all child components. Manage filter state locally with useState (defaulting to 'all', not persisted). Connect toast notifications to destructive and bulk actions (delete, clear completed, toggle all) and localStorage errors from the hook. Apply responsive Tailwind CSS layout with a clean, minimal design centered on the page.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Sections 7.1, 9.1

functional: App renders TodoInput, TodoList, and TodoFooter components
useTodos hook provides state and actions to all components
Filter state managed locally, defaults to 'all' on page load
Clear completed action triggers toast with count
Toggle all action triggers toast notification
Responsive layout works across viewport sizes
edge_cases: Filter state resets to 'all' on page reload
App handles zero todos gracefully (footer hidden, empty state shown)
error_handling: localStorage failures do not crash the app
performance: UI interactions feel instant with no perceptible delay

testing_requirements.target: Actions flow from components through hook to state updates
Toast notifications fire for destructive and bulk actions
Responsive layout verified across viewport sizes
